brief: You write realistic requests for an AI coding assistant. The request asks it to build a single-page website saved as index.html in the current directory (inline CSS/JS, no build step). Keep the request short and loose, the way someone types when they want the assistant to make the design calls: 2-4 sentences of what the site is for and who it's for. End with exactly this sentence: "Make it look world-class: run the design loop, and don't stop to ask me questions, pick sensible defaults."

twist: it should feel like a quest game
it should read like a printed newspaper
it must work for people skimming on a phone
it has to look premium on a tiny budget
it should feel playful without being childish
it needs a strong single call to action
it should feel calm and trustworthy
the owner hates generic startup aesthetics
